by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C A' B' C' _ _ h
  exact ⟨h.dist_eq 0 1, h.dist_eq 1 2, h.dist_eq 2 0, EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_of_congruent h 0 1 2,
    EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_of_congruent h 1 2 0, EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_of_congruent h 2 0 1⟩
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C A' B' C' : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → ¬Collinear ℝ ({A', B', C'} : Set P) → Congruent ![A, B, C] ![A', B', C'] → dist A B = dist A' B' ∧ dist B C = dist B' C' ∧ dist C A = dist C' A' ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C = EuclideanGeometry.angle A' B' C' ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle B C A = EuclideanGeometry.angle B' C' A' ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle C A B = EuclideanGeometry.angle C' A' B'
